heading: An asymmetric canvas
subtext: Cards of varying heights create a dynamic, editorial-feel layout that breaks out of the rigid grid.

items.title: Organic visual rhythm
items.description: Cards have varying heights based on content length, creating a natural editorial feel.

items.title: Theme-colored accents
items.description: Each card pulls from the theme's color palette. A consistent system that feels varied.

items.title: No JavaScript masonry
items.description: Pure CSS columns. No layout shift, no measurement, no expensive JS libraries.

items.title: Responsive columns
items.description: 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop. Cards reflow naturally.

items.title: Content-first heights
items.description: Each card's height is driven by its content. Longer descriptions naturally get more visual weight.
